evidence: The thin-ﬁlm growth of a-Fe2O3 was performed with Fe(thd)3 (Hthd: 2,2,6,6-tetramethylheptan-3,5-dione) as iron precursor and ozone as oxygen source. Most ﬁlms were grown with 10 000 cycles at 186 8C, which gave ﬁlms with a thickness of ca. 110 nm (11 pm/cycle). One cycle consisted of a 1-s Fe(thd)3 pulse, 1-s purge with N2, 2-s O3 pulse, and 1-s purge with N2.
